chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from ʿAbd Allah ibn Miskān, from Ibn Abī Yaʿfūr, who said:
I heard Abā ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام say: The daytime prayer may be made up at whatever hour you wish, during the night or the day.

key_terms.النَّهَارِ: the daytime; indicating the original time of the prayer
key_terms.سَاعَةٍ: an hour or time; meaning any time
key_terms.صَلَاةُ: prayer; here referring to the devotional prayer being discussed
key_terms.قَضَاؤُهَا: making it up; performing the missed prayer later
key_terms.لَيْلٍ: night; one of the valid times for making up the prayer
key_terms.نَهَارٍ: day; also a valid time for making up the prayer

ai.seo_question: When can missed daytime nawafil prayers be made up according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states that missed daytime nawafil prayers may be performed as qada' at any time one wishes, whether during the night or the day. It indicates flexibility in the time for making up such missed devotional prayers.
